h: Shirley, west of the city centre
p: Shirley High Street is the main shopping street in Shirley, a busy suburb a couple of miles north-west of Southampton city centre, with plenty of independent shops, cafés and takeaways. It's on several of the main bus routes into town, so it's easy to get to without a car.

Southampton Common, a huge stretch of woodland and grassland, is a short walk east, and great for a stroll. For something different in the city centre, SeaCity Museum tells the story of Southampton's link with the Titanic, and long stretches of the medieval city walls are still standing to walk along.
Game Nation Shirley is 18+, so it's one for the grown-ups.
